name: K Corp. HP Ampules
description: K Corp.'s HP Ampules, break and consume them when sustaining serious damage. At the start of the scene, you may consume 1x HP Ampule to recover 90% of your Max HP and Max Stagger Resist.

name: Old T Corp. Watch
description: An old T Corp. Watch, it still ticks. For 3 battles, gain 1 Haste at the end of every scene of those battles.

name: Deluxe T Corp. Watch
description: A Deluxe T Corp. Watch, it looks gorgeous. For 3 battles, gain 2 Haste at the end of every scene of those battles.

name: Gorilla Bolus
description: A Bolus rolled up into a ball. At the start of a scene, consume 1x Gorilla Bolus to gain 2 Strength.

name: Ape Bolus
description: Three Boluses rolled up into pills. At the start of the scene, consume 1x Ape Bolus to apply 1 Strength to three allies (including yourself).

name: Porcupine Bolus
description: A Bolus rolled up into a ball. At the start of a scene, consume 1x Porcupine Bolus to gain 3 Thorns.

name: Tortoise Bolus
description: A Bolus rolled up into a ball. At the start of a scene, consume 1x Tortoise Bolus to gain 2 Endurance.

name: Terrapin Bolus
description: Three Boluses rolled up into pills. At the start of the scene, consume 1x Terrapin Bolus to apply 1 Endurance to three allies (including yourself).

name: Fox Bolus
description: A Bolus rolled up into a ball. At the start of a scene, consume 1x Fox Bolus to gain 2 Haste.

name: Wolf Bolus
description: Three Boluses rolled up into pills. At the start of a scene, consume 1x Wolf Bolus to apply 1 Haste to three allies (including yourself).

name: Bee Comb Perfume
description: "Honey sweet aroma, attracts everyone"™ At the start of a scene, consume 1x Bee Comb Perfume to gain 6 Aggro.

name: Fixer Magazine
description: Be updated on the newest Fixer trends, and maybe gain some inspiration. Consume 1x Fixer Magazine, then remove 1 Anxiety and gain 2 Excellence.

name: Boombox of Dramatic Entrances
description: Great to enact some vengeance. At the start of a scene, consume 1x Boombox of Dramatic Entrances for all allies to gain 3 Emotion Points (including yourself).

name: Broken Greatsword
description: The best defense, but unfortunately it wasn't enough. At the start of a scene, consume 1x Broken Greatsword to gain or apply 2 Protection to an ally.

name: Backpack
description: A backpack. It can hold a lot of items to lighten the burden. +2 Inventory space.

name: Sharp Needle & Thread
description: Sharp Needle and Thread, to stitch things up. After the use of the first skill that dealt damage in this scene, the target takes damage = half the total damage that skill dealt (after all modifiers).

name: Recorded Logs of that Day
description: Guidance to not repeat that day. When becoming staggered, recover all Stagger Resist and gain 12 Poise. This effect activates once per Mission.

name: Bridle
description: Face your sins. Gain +10 Max HP and +5 Max Stagger Resist for every Boss battle you have fought in this mission (up to 30 and 15 respectively).

name: Broken Blade
description: The broken blade of a Hwando. On hit, if it was critical, deal additional damage = half the total damage dealt (after all modifiers).

name: Tangled Bones
description: A bundle of bones from a certain Abnormality. Offensive Dice on a skill that can inflict Sinking gain +1 Power.

name: Interlocked Cogs
description: Interlocked brass cogs. Offensive Dice on a skill that can inflict Tremor gain +1 Power.

name: Decamillenal Stewpot
description: A stewpot containing a stone soup. Offensive Dice on a skill that can inflict Burn gain +1 Power.

name: Recollection of a Certain Day
description: An old portrait, the face in it is obscured. Offensive Dice on a skill that can gain Poise gain +1 Power.

name: Millarca
description: A torn rose from a certain Abnormality. Offensive Dice on a skill that can inflict Bleed gain +1 Power.

name: Thorny Rope Cuffs
description: Thorny vines made to catch someone. Offensive Dice on a skill that can inflict Rupture gain +1 Power.

name: T-1B Octagonal Bolt
description: An octagonal bolt made out of plastic. Offensive Dice on a skill that can gain Charge gain +1 Power.
